newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht rallies offshore, interbank steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht rallies offshore, interbank steady late.

text.p: The Thai baht rallied sharply against the dollar in offshore markets as costly swap premiums drove foreign players to sell spot dollars to raise funds for covering their short baht positions, dealers said.
"Now offshore players want baht to fund positions. The swap is very high so they are selling spot," said one dealer at a local bank.
The baht was traded offshore at 24.360/24.410 to the dollar late against 24.500/24.600 in the early morning. The baht steadied onshore at 25.840/25.850 late against 25.840/25.860 earlier.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium rose offshore to 150/200 satangs per dollar late from 125/165 in the morning. In the domestic market, the one-month swap premium steadied at 20/30 satangs.
The overnight interbank rate stood unchanged at 15.00-16.00 percent on sustained tight liquidity partly due to corporate tax payment and bank reserve requirement due later this week, dealers said.
